axes.model_access: Hailuo has grown from a single first-party model entry into a multi-model studio: its official account page lists the Hailuo 2.3/2.0/1.0 family and MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3.0) alongside 12+ video models including Veo 3.1, Sora 2 and Seedance 2.0. H3’s official specs are 768p/2K, 4–15 s, 24fps and 32 kHz native stereo, with text-to-video, first/last-frame and Omni Reference modes (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web at hailuoai.video, mobile apps and the MiniMax open-platform async API (`/v2/video_generation`, bearer auth); H3-Base weights were open-sourced on 2026-08-03 and can run locally at 768p via SGLang/vLLM/diffusers/ComfyUI, while 2K regeneration stays on the official API (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Product-side assets and outputs live in the account cloud, and free downloads carry a watermark; the open H3-Base weights, inference and 768p output can stay entirely local, while the 2K regeneration module is not part of the open release and requires the official API. The two data boundaries differ (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Cloud async tasks: `POST /v2/video_generation` returns a `task_id`, clients poll Query Task for status and read `content.url` on success, with List/Cancel/Delete and only the last seven days of task records kept. Console generation queues by plan priority, with paid tiers ahead (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: H3: text-to-video, first-frame/first-and-last-frame, Omni Reference (≤9 images + ≤3 videos + ≤3 audio, ≤12 files total), instruction-based video editing (replace/add/remove subjects and objects, change background and light, revise dialogue and voice), native stereo, up to 15 s, 2K and six ratios from 21:9 to 9:16. Hailuo 2.3: text/image-to-video at 768p/1080p for 6/10 s, with 2.3-Fast limited to image-to-video (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Work is organised by generation tasks and output history; one generation puts text, images, video and audio into a single multimodal context, and Omni Reference keeps character, motion, camera and voice consistent through reference files. Chat context is not carried across sessions, so reuse relies on explicit reference assets (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Account plus a free tier and paid subscriptions (Standard/Pro/Master/Ultra/Max) with credits (shells); free output is watermarked and personal-use only, while paid tiers remove the watermark and retain commercial rights. Open H3 weights follow the MiniMax H3 Community License, whose revenue threshold and attribution terms govern commercial use; the API is billed separately (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: one entry point for comparing models, H3 native audio-video and reference-driven generation, ad/e-commerce/short-drama shots and local 768p open-weight deployment. Not fit: free commercial use, the lowest price on a single model or fully offline 2K (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the Hailuo model pages, the H3 open-source announcement, the MiniMax API overview and the paid/usage terms. Per-model availability, credit costs and 2K stability need account-level testing.
unknowns:
- Public weight coverage per H3 variant: H3-Base FL2VA/Ref2VA are open, while H3-Context-IR and H3-Regenerate-2K remain hosted by MiniMax.
- Commercial licence revenue threshold and attribution: follow the MiniMax H3 Community License text.
- Credit prices per model tier: follow the live generation panel and subscription page.
related: Both domestic video heavyweights: Kling's ecosystem surface (app/plugins) is wider, Hailuo's entry is lighter.
Both domestic image+video one-stop entries: Jimeng embeds in the CapCut ecosystem, Hailuo is a standalone video site.
